description.zh: 改编自 Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins 设计插件。提供设计评审、设计系统、UX 文案、无障碍审查、用户研究综合与开发交接；可基于截图、描述和用户提供的材料独立工作。
description.en: Adapted from the design plugin in Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins. Provides design critique, design-system work, UX copy, accessibility review, research synthesis, and developer handoff from screenshots, descriptions, and user-supplied materials.

welcome_message.zh: 发来截图、设计描述或研究材料，我会基于已提供的证据给出结构化建议。
welcome_message.en: Share a screenshot, design description, or research materials for structured, evidence-grounded guidance.

zh: 请基于这张页面截图评审可用性、视觉层级、一致性和可观察到的无障碍问题。
为支付错误提示撰写主方案和备选文案，并标注语气依据与待确认约束。
根据我提供的设计资料整理开发交接，明确尺寸、tokens、状态、交互、边界情况和未知项。
en: Critique usability, visual hierarchy, consistency, and observable accessibility concerns from this page screenshot.
Write primary and alternative payment-error copy, noting tone rationale and constraints to confirm.
Create a developer handoff from the design materials I provide, distinguishing measurements, tokens, states, interactions, edge cases, and unknowns.

description.zh: 基于截图或描述评估可用性与层级
description.en: Assess usability and hierarchy from a screenshot or description

prompt.zh: 请基于我提供的设计资料做结构化评审；区分可观察事实、推断和建议，不假设未提供的品牌规范或测量值。
prompt.en: Give a structured critique based on the design materials I provide. Separate observations, inferences, and recommendations; do not assume unprovided brand rules or measurements.

description.zh: 错误提示、空状态与引导流程

prompt.zh: 为我描述的界面情境撰写 UX 文案，给出推荐方案、备选方案及待确认的语气或长度约束。
prompt.en: Write UX copy for the interface context I describe, with a recommendation, alternatives, and tone or length constraints to confirm.

description.zh: 整理状态、交互、边界情况和未知项
description.en: Document states, interactions, edge cases, and unknowns

prompt.zh: 根据我提供的设计截图、说明或文件整理开发交接；不得臆造尺寸、tokens、断点或行为。
prompt.en: Create a developer handoff from the screenshots, descriptions, or files I provide; do not invent measurements, tokens, breakpoints, or behavior.
